reply.summary: Nusranno is a balding, brown-haired racketeer who runs a harbour-side smuggling ring from behind a respectable shipping firm. He hires others to do his violence.

feats.scene: Nusranno swings a cane across a courier's jaw.
Nusranno stumbles down a loading ramp and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Vacel is a red-eyed, blue-haired monster fused from four linked minds, with a chef as its ruling will. It devours thoughts to become real and bursts from the skulls of its victims, but dreads feathered flocks.

feats.scene: Vacel erupts from a victim's head and hurls the wreckage across a hall.
Vacel holds together under a collapsing ceiling in its dream-maze.

reply.summary: Serlleseo is a blue-skinned daughter of a primeval sea goddess, raised in a hidden fishing hamlet. She can change into a clawed, winged amphibian form and take to the air.

feats.scene: Serlleseo dives from the clouds in winged form and rips a trawler in half.
Serlleseo rides out a towering wave that smashes a pier to splinters.

reply.summary: Nonto is a red-haired, black-eyed caretaker who tells spooky tales to guests of a crooked old manor. He seems more at ease with ghosts than with people.

feats.scene: Nonto slams a heavy door against a draught.
Nonto stands unruffled while the cellar shakes.

reply.summary: Tiritel is the first killer in human history, cursed to roam for ages and now a boastful storyteller who keeps a haunted manor in a realm of dreams. He serves a pale lord of tales.

feats.scene: Tiritel clubs a monster off the manor roof with one blow.
Tiritel is struck down and rises again unharmed, as he has done for millennia.

reply.summary: Nenannto is a red-haired spirit warden of a vast jungle who rides a wild boar through the undergrowth and speaks with beasts. She cannot die while the trees stand.

feats.scene: Nenannto calls her boar into a charge that topples a stand of ancient trunks.
Nenannto walks out of a roaring wildfire untouched.

reply.summary: Celau is a tall, slender former catwalk model who now runs her late father's trading firm and answers to a shadowy cabal. Her weapons are contracts and bribes.

feats.scene: Celau slaps a rival executive across the face.
Celau steps from a wrecked limousine with a bruised arm.

reply.summary: Citesve is a towering red-haired university student with latent gene-engineered gifts, able to swell her muscles into a hulking frame. She grows tougher and stronger as she grows larger.

feats.scene: Citesve heaves a stalled lorry over a barrier in a single throw.
Citesve absorbs a rocket blast to the chest and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Orern is a white-haired lab agent in an altered timeline who serves a false saviour and wields a chilling second persona. She guards a prison corridor against escapees.

feats.scene: Orern flash-freezes a corridor floor and sends guards skidding.
Orern shrugs off a hard tackle into a steel locker.

reply.summary: Tersorno is a blue-skinned, white-haired scientist-turned-felon who drains heat from her surroundings and freezes foes. She also fights with acrobatic hand-to-hand moves.

feats.scene: Tersorno glazes a whole street in ice with an outstretched hand.
Tersorno absorbs a blast and turns it into a freezing wave.

reply.summary: Rorllo is a bald, green-eyed army enforcer who murders lab researchers to seize experimental body dyes. He daubs himself with them to gain a spread of abilities.

feats.scene: Rorllo punches through a plasterboard wall while charged with pigment.
Rorllo is thrown against a truck and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Vesaar is a red-haired city hero with great strength and unbreakable skin who fights alongside a squad of caped volunteers. He is protective of his younger sister.

feats.scene: Vesaar hurls a parked bus clear across a plaza.
Vesaar stands unflinching in a gas explosion.

reply.summary: Staanle is a blonde frontier-themed bandit who serves as right hand to her fiance's gang of modern outlaws. She is fiercely loyal to her mother.

feats.scene: Staanle lassos a guard and yanks him off his feet.
Staanle rolls clear of a runaway wagon and brushes off her chaps.

reply.summary: Iarcesent is a brown-haired soldier from a grim possible future whose cybernetic skin lets him vanish into backdrops and whose fingers end in claws. He serves a machine warlord.

feats.scene: Iarcesent rakes his claws through a steel plate.
Iarcesent survives a rifle burst through his reinforced plating.

reply.summary: Tetocer is a bald, tattooed dungeon prisoner in a medieval fortress, held when other captives were freed because his crimes were real. He studies days and dates in his cell.

feats.scene: Tetocer rattles his chains against an iron grate.
Tetocer endures weeks of cold stone and hunger.

reply.summary: Coniuli is a grey, red-eyed, hairless half-angelic son of a fallen being and a witch. He wrenched out his own heart to be weighed in a death-realm and slew a crocodile devourer of souls.

feats.scene: Coniuli tears a monstrous reptile apart with his bare hands.
Coniuli rips out his heart, lives on, and regrows it.

reply.summary: Ntorne is a demon of slaughter that boasts of having driven a famous lamplit-street killer and later slips into the body of a royal to strengthen the crown from within.

feats.scene: Ntorne drives a possessed host to smash a banquet table in two.
Ntorne leaves a burning host and takes another unscathed.

reply.summary: Valsanter is a cruel ancient tyrant who ruled by terror, was cut down by conspirators, and now languishes among the damned, fed on spilled blood by demons for two thousand years.

feats.scene: Valsanter drives a ceremonial dagger into a senator's chest.
Valsanter endures a hundred stabs from plotters.

reply.summary: Rnitau is a black-haired government scientist who seeded a nuclear test with a mutating vapour, creating hundreds of psychic four-thumbed children and later brainwashing them to build a world-conquest array.

feats.scene: Rnitau powers a weather machine with mutant minds and flattens a test range.
Rnitau survives a collapsing console in his bunker.

reply.summary: Rausesul is a yellow-eyed sentient plant who sprouted on a scorched world, refused to die, and became one of the earliest ring-wielders. She grows life and projects green constructs.

feats.scene: Rausesul grows a forest canopy over a burnt continent-sized basin in a moment.
Rausesul holds a ring barrier against a blazing monster before falling.

reply.summary: Tosialo is a green-eyed high school basketball player with a short orange crop and a nose stud who keeps her friends close and her teammates at arm's length.

feats.scene: Tosialo fires a hard pass the length of the court.
Tosialo hits the hardwood in a scramble and bounces up.

reply.summary: Lorlen is a dark-haired island warrior who trained beside her fiercest sister-in-arms in an age of global war and is cut down by an accidental blade during a thief's raid.

feats.scene: Lorlen drives a spear through a training shield.
Lorlen takes a heavy sword blow on her bracer and holds her ground.

reply.summary: Ntent is a blond, blue-eyed deathless goddess of epic verse, imprisoned by greedy authors who feed on her inspiration until a dream-king frees her. Ancient bylaws bind her to any mortal who burns her scroll.

feats.scene: Ntent whispers a verse that drives a poet to write through the night.
Ntent survives years of captivity without aging.

reply.summary: Rorasti is a brown-haired cave explorer who tunnels under ghost-ridden towns and teams up with a talking dog's gang of mystery solvers.

feats.scene: Rorasti swings a pickaxe into a cavern wall.
Rorasti drops down a shaft on a rope and lands upright.

reply.summary: Titau is a brown-haired spelunker who drives a drill-nosed rig through bedrock and guides costumed visitors through lost caverns.

feats.scene: Titau bores his rig through a granite ridge.
Titau rides out a cave-in inside his armoured cab.

reply.summary: Namiacar is a black-haired mercenary who believed a sea-tyrant's promises of a homeland, was thrown overboard through a torpedo tube, survived thanks to gill implants, and became mayor of an undersea town.

feats.scene: Namiacar punches out a guard in a submarine corridor.
Namiacar is blasted out of a torpedo tube into open water and swims on.

reply.summary: Tiatel is a tall builder who dies far from home with no kin to claim him, and whose name and body are later borrowed by a blue demigod for a human life.

feats.scene: Tiatel hauls a bag of cement onto a scaffold.
Tiatel falls from a low wall and gets back to work.

reply.summary: Viresra is a seven-foot refugee turned brainwashed assassin and warlord whose fencing blades are treated to slice through almost any material.

feats.scene: Viresra cuts a steel door clean through with one treated blade.
Viresra endures a hard throw into a jungle stone.

reply.summary: Taniunus is a brown-haired federal investigator with a talent for tactics and leadership, carrying a service pistol and leading task forces against odd criminals.

feats.scene: Taniunus fires a service pistol at a fleeing suspect's tyre.
Taniunus ducks behind a car door as shots ring out.

reply.summary: Veseam is a blond, green-eyed former detective who joins a secret government unit after her costumed father is murdered. She crosses paths with a mischievous sorcerer boy and survives his wrath.

feats.scene: Veseam fires a service pistol through a cultist's lantern.
Veseam crawls from a toppled filing cabinet unhurt.

reply.summary: Tumsose is a black-haired industrialist who builds a great bridge to join his sprawling city to the countryside in honour of his son.

feats.scene: Tumsose swings a ceremonial hammer to open the span.
Tumsose stands unmoved at a roaring construction site.

reply.summary: Iaser is a blue-skinned, white-haired teenage villain who hurls ice spears from the supports of a suspension bridge for the attention of heroes.

feats.scene: Iaser flips a row of cars with a wave of frozen spikes.
Iaser is clipped by an arrow and drops from the span.

reply.summary: Lleesi is a pale-skinned, white-eyed villain who makes chilly puns and freezes things, joining a gang of cold-themed crooks to freeze a city and stealing a sports trophy.

feats.scene: Lleesi coats a harbour district in thick ice with his gang.
Lleesi is knocked out by a pursuing hero's tackle.

reply.summary: Tiaviva is a seafaring marauder with command over frost, crewing a mercenary ship that is boarded by sea-folk. He freezes a handful of raiders before gunfire fells him.

feats.scene: Tiaviva freezes three boarders solid on the deck.
Tiaviva stands for a moment under a hail of rounds.

reply.summary: Vieontel is a black- and grey-haired former silent-film actress who rents rooms to a heroine and keeps her fencing skills sharp.

feats.scene: Vieontel parries a burglar's bat with an old prop foil.
Vieontel stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

reply.summary: Nalsorreo is a red-haired, blue-eyed thief and assassin for hire who vanishes under a stolen stealth garment and is skilled in hand-to-hand combat.

feats.scene: Nalsorreo drops from the ceiling and strikes a guard unseen.
Nalsorreo falls through a skylight and rolls away.

reply.summary: Iucortil is a teenage runaway who steals an alien gem from a cult's submarine, and it bonds to her as a near-impenetrable second skin that grants strange powers.

feats.scene: Iucortil bursts out of a sub hatch and shatters a rail.
Iucortil takes a hail of cult gunfire on her gem-skin without a mark.

reply.summary: Sosticil is an orange-skinned heiress turned warrior, mutated by a protester's bomb into a hulking form, who joins a team of young heroes and is slain in a distant galaxy.

feats.scene: Sosticil punches a hole through an armoured hull.
Sosticil stands against a blast that levels a hangar.

reply.summary: Tumvarnti is a brown-haired teenager who sold strength-boosting pills to make ends meet and later gave up her supplier to help her boyfriend's family.

feats.scene: Tumvarnti slams a locker door in frustration.
Tumvarnti hits the ground on an icy path and gets up.

reply.summary: Cinora is an ancient white-eyed wish-granting deity, born in a child's mind and fated to coat the world in wax. He is bound to serve the girl who refuses to fight him.

feats.scene: Cinora wraps a district of a city in hardened wax in one breath.
Cinora melts and reforms after fire and blades pass through him.

reply.summary: Ronsia is a thought-born egregore wearing a white-eyed wax body, fed by the world's dread of annihilation and channelled through a girl's wishes until a team halts him.

feats.scene: Ronsia unleashes a wave of molten wax that swallows a hillside town.
Ronsia reforms from a pool of wax after being blasted apart.

reply.summary: Llanum is a nineteenth-century seal-hunting ship's master who races a rival to remote ice-fields, wrestling with sabotage, a stowaway boy, and a damaged hull.

feats.scene: Llanum hurls a harpoon from the bow of his three-masted ship.
Llanum keeps his footing on a pitching deck in a gale.

reply.summary: Colultiu is a black-haired, strongest member of a gang of paperboys turned heroes who grows bored with adventures and becomes a college athlete before a sinister tailor twists his fate.

feats.scene: Colultiu hurls a pigskin the length of a field.
Colultiu takes a savage beating in a swamp and still stands.

reply.summary: Rnitiu is a white-haired, blue-eyed gangster who commands a speedboat crew, endangers fishermen to escape, and hunts a long-buried hoard under a college campus.

feats.scene: Rnitiu rams a fishing boat with his speedboat prow.
Rnitiu clings to a wet deck as waves smash over him.

reply.summary: Serni is a white-haired, ruthless sea raider who boards a small boat, holds a couple hostage in a hunt for treasure, and is dragged under by a summoned tentacled beast.

feats.scene: Serni fires a pistol into a boat's hull.
Serni is seized by a huge tentacle and survives briefly.

reply.summary: Erulleval is a brown-haired sea thief who attacks a pleasure cruiser for the guests' jewels and is locked in a magical cage by a sorceress before the sea king can arrive.

feats.scene: Erulleval fires a pistol at the cruiser's safe door.
Erulleval shoulders a lounge door and bounces off.

reply.summary: Corsasve is a grey-haired, blue-eyed sea raider who threatens captives with the plank and plans a Pacific empire in the wake of a surprise naval raid.

feats.scene: Corsasve swings a cutlass through a hawser.
Corsasve takes a fall down a ship's companionway and bellows on.

reply.summary: Aullra is a blond schoolboy surfer at an academy for young heroes who flashes a dazzling grin that sears the eyes and rides a flying board.

feats.scene: Aullra flashes a blinding grin that scorches a training dummy.
Aullra crashes his board into a gym wall and walks off.
Aullra skims above the rooftops on his board.

reply.summary: Iueon is a red-haired member of a trio of junior safety patrollers, strong enough to hoist a small vehicle overhead.

feats.scene: Iueon lifts a small truck off a trapped child.
Iueon is clipped by a runaway cart and shrugs.

reply.summary: Serse is a grinning android built by a villainous prankster to pilot a refuse barge spreading a laughing toxin. Its brute strength and metal frame easily overpower a masked hero until a car crusher ends it.

feats.scene: Serse hurls a masked hero through a wall of the barge cabin.
Serse takes a heavy truck impact and keeps walking.
